visualCharacteristics.purpose: Compact bonus-tier table placed inside a step list
visualCharacteristics.layout: Narrow centered table; header row, row separators, emphasized first column
visualCharacteristics.notes: Brand header fill and value color are left to the design pass.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: column headers (e.g. bonus, required deposits); following rows: one tier per row

usage: Small tier/lookup tables highlighted in the page body.
reuseGuidance: Use for short highlighted tier tables. For plain gridded tables in legal copy use table-bordered.
